commits.title: Enhance Christmas login theme and implement Azure telemetry
commits.before_text: Christmas login lighting used the earlier effect implementation, and the application lacked the new opt-in server telemetry integration.
commits.after_text: Refines Christmas login lighting, snow and interaction styling. Adds opt-in server telemetry to WSGI/ASGI startup with settings, dependency updates, deployment guidance and dedicated regression tests.
